limitations: The opaque floor patches preserve original shadow and ground RGB. They are not physical translucent shadows; moving a statue requires repainting its floor connection.
Only visible painted pixels are extracted; no hidden geometry is invented. Plinth ivy belongs to the cutout where it crosses the visible outer silhouette.
The left staff is a separate authored component polygon within the same statue group so its narrow contour and the open gap beside the robe remain transparent.
Binary masks preserve exact original pixels. Already-antialiased source edges include mixed background colours; edge cleanup may be needed when reusing a cutout elsewhere.
The clean plate replaces only reconstruction cores plus short soft transitions. Pixels outside these supports stay original; all groups shown must reproduce every original pixel.
Hidden Blender guides are the grounded geometry before painting and need visual alignment; their native 1600x900 data is not registered exactly to the 1672x941 painting.
